improvement_relation.basis: The implementation reuses the existing owner-pass contract and execution trace, correlates decisions and results within the same selected session, and exposes the result source references. Tests independently validate correlation and compact output; the live projection confirms the seven-pass relationship.
not_measured: agent opportunities or need for any owner pass
agent receipt or reduced intervention burden
service correctness beyond the recorded projection and tests
cross-session recurrence or generalization to other service domains

measurement_basis: Implementation, focused regression verification, and post-change read-only ECI trace inspection.

outcome.implementation_change: The existing ECI service-accountability view now correlates its selected-session Environment owner-pass contract with the ambient scheduler trace. Compact views carry bounded decision and result observations with source identity; a later disposition extension preserves the raw router code and wave without interpreting them as service verdicts.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The readback proves scheduler and result relationships are inspectable. It does not show agent need, receipt, correctness, or reduced intervention; runner-returned-none is not treated as failure.
outcome.verified_change: The final capability-intelligence test module passes 161 tests. The live session exposes seven scheduled decisions, complete decision coverage, two exact Store-backed result links, five runner-returned-none records, and zero owner failures.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment service-accountability and session-activity projections
